Name: CP - Willy's Legs Closed
Author: Polygoners
Description:
The mod gives Willy baggy, nicer-looking pants, and that's about it.

[list]
[*]Works with Winter!
[*]Compatible with portraits!
[*]There is a file you can use for "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21370]Looking For Love[/url]﻿", make sure to follow the instructions in the mod folder if you have LFL installed, it won't work if you don't!
[/list]
If you want this to work with a certain portrait, just ask!
